name: package export declaration order keeps completion stable

sources.text: package pkg_a; parameter int ALPHA = 1; endpackage
package pkg_b; parameter int BETA = 2; endpackage
package api; import pkg_b::*; import pkg_a::*; export pkg_b::*; export pkg_a::*; endpackage
module top; import api::*; localparam int A = ALP; endmodule
